name: collections.ChainMap
summary: Search mappings in order; write new values to the first mapping.

examples.code:
defaults = {'color': 'blue', 'size': 2}
options = collections.ChainMap({'color': 'red'}, defaults)
options['size'] = 3
(options['color'], options['size'], defaults['size'])

differs: Gives Python 3.14.8's answer on a probe of edge values of each argument (scripts/catalog-probe.py; catalog/python/probes/stdlib.json), and accepts every argument of its signature; not reviewed line by line.
